Keeps your screen on for as long as you want, from the app or a Quick Settings tile, and puts everything back exactly as it was when you turn it off.

## Features

- **Two ways to stay awake.** *Timeout* raises the system screen timeout to its maximum with nothing running in the background. *Wake lock* leaves your timeout alone and uses a tiny service that pauses whenever the screen is off.
- **Your timeout comes back.** The app remembers the timeout you had and restores that exact value, not a default. If you change the timeout yourself while it's on, your new choice is kept.
- **Quick Settings tile.** Turn it on or off from the notification shade. Long-press the tile to open the app.
- **Survives the unexpected.** Reboots, force-stops and the system killing the app are all detected, so the app and tile always show the real state.
- Light and dark themes, and very low battery and memory use.

## Download

Get **`screen-on-v1.0.0.apk`**. Requires Android 7.0 or newer. Android may offer to scan the app before installing, because it doesn't come from the Play Store. Tap "Scan app" and it will install normally.

Timeout mode needs the "Modify system settings" permission; the app takes you to the right screen the first time.
